subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental persistent `claws add` lifecycle in core and sponsor landing this write slice after its still-open read-only planning base?
rationale: The remaining question is not a narrow correctness repair: the patch adds a public mutation flow, persistent install ownership, and a multi-PR lifecycle whose long-term core ownership and upgrade story require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
options.body: Confirm the experimental Claw lifecycle belongs in core, keep the shared SQLite provenance contract, and review/land the stack in dependency order.

options.title: Keep Claws read-only for now
options.body: Retain planning-only behavior until maintainers choose a narrower lifecycle owner or a different distribution boundary.

options.title: Pause the stack for an RFC decision
options.body: Defer this write slice until the lifecycle, cleanup, and compatibility commitments are explicitly settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Confirm the experimental Claw lifecycle belongs in core, keep the shared SQLite provenance contract, and review/land the stack in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct involvement in the stack discussion, while the final decision is product sponsorship rather than a mechanical contributor fix.
